comments.body: The singular-key fix is good; please drop the id_for/Resource additions (it is an undocumented, out-of-scope feature)

Done: removed the `id_for` helper and the Resource-by-slug matching (plus the extra `reviewers` association and its test). `records_for_ids` is back to its original form; the PR now only reads the singular `*_ids` key (keeping the plural as fallback), with the docs line and tests for both keys.

*(Drafted with Claude Code; not run locally by the author.)*
